text:
maria: FYI — during the node drain on gpu-pool-3 I saw prometheus agent relay enter a retry loop. remote_write 502/504s and queue depth spiked. After sidecars restarted we got a huge influx of series duplicates. Not sure if relabeling/state is lost on shutdown. Anyone seen this?

kevin: Hmm. That sounds like sidecars re-registering with slightly different labelsets during restart — could be dynamic labels like pod_uid or ephemeral metrics causing new series. Can you paste agent logs?

maria: Pasting the last few lines from the agent that hit the retries:
```
Jun 14 03:12:07 prometheus-agent[3245]: level=error ts=2026-06-14T03:12:07Z component=remote write err="write failed: 502 Bad Gateway"
Jun 14 03:12:07 prometheus-agent[3245]: level=warn ts=2026-06-14T03:12:07Z component=queue remote_write_queue_len=62134
Jun 14 03:12:08 prometheus-agent[3245]: level=error ts=2026-06-14T03:12:08Z msg="received out-of-order samples or duplicate series" series_labelset="{pod=\"sidecar-xyz\", gpu_id=\"0\", container_id=\"...\"}"
```

tom: Did you see any 400s complaining about label cardinality? 502/504s could be gateway/backpressure but duplicates suggest relabeling gaps.

maria: There were a few 400s earlier: "remote_write: bad request: exceeded series limit for tenant" — looks like surge of unique series when sidecars reconnected.

alice: Two quick guesses: 1) the sidecar restart changed a label (pod_uid or start_time) so Prometheus sees new series; 2) the agent's relabel configs are not applied on in-flight reconnections. Short-term: drop pod_uid and any ephemeral labels via relabel_config. Example to drop pod UID:
```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_uid"]
    regex: ".*"
    action: drop
```
Also check remote_write.queue_config.max_samples_per_send and capacity — they can back up and cause retries.

kevin: +1 to dropping ephemeral labels. Also check service discovery annotations — if we're scraping both pod IP and host network during drain you can get duplicate targets. Grep for annotations: 
```bash
kubectl get pods -n metrics -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, annotations: .metadata.annotations}' | grep prometheus.io/scrape -B2 -A2
```

maria: Good call. I also noticed our relabel rules don't remove `container_id`. That changes on restart. I'm going to patch a relabel drop for container_id and kubernetes_pod_uid, roll it to a couple agents first.

sre-bot: ALERT: RemoteWriteQueueHighSamples fired (prometheus-agent/gpu-pool-3). queue_length=62000 p95_write_latency=3.2s

deploy-bot: Rolling canary: prometheus-agent-relabeller v2 -> patching agents in gpu-pool-3 (2/12). PreStop hook added to allow 15s graceful shutdown for scrapes.

kevin: Also consider tuning remote_write backoff and batch sizes to avoid transient 502s turning into huge backlogs. Example queue_config tweaks: 
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://remote-write.example/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 5000
      capacity: 250000
      min_shards: 1
      max_shards: 8
```
Lowering max_samples_per_send reduces single-write payloads and may help gateways.

tom: Longer-term: add preStop that flips a `prometheus.io/scrape: \"false\"` annotation or have the sidecar respond 410 for a short window during shutdown so the agent drops targets cleanly. Also, we should add a relabel unit test in our onboarding job to catch ephemeral labels.

maria: Patch applied to canary agents. Monitoring queue depth and remote_write 5xxs. If stable for 10m I'll roll to rest. Tagging @oncall to watch dashboards (slo: remote_write_success_rate). :eyes:

alice: One more note — if the remote-write gateway returns 502 under load, we should have an automated fallback route to a regional replica. Routing policy might help avoid single-point gateway pressure.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update when canary finishes. If you have quick checks to run against sidecars, drop them here and I'll run.

kevin: Quick check: run `curl -sS http://<sidecar>:9100/metrics | head -n 50 | grep container_id` to confirm ephemeral labels. Also check grafana panel `prometheus_agent/remote_write_queue{job=\"agent\"}` for the spike pattern.

maria: Done. Confirmed container_id present. Canary looks stable at +2m and queue depth is declining. Rolling to remaining agents now. Will follow up in 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: 12/12 agents patched in gpu-pool-3.

maria: Roll complete. Remote_write success_rate back to normal. Closing follow-up ticket for long-term: add relabel unittest and graceful-scrape shutdown hook.

kevin: Nice. Filing RFC for graceful shutdown strategy next week. :thumbsup:
